dedupe_keys.name: southern dominican urban wind and meteorology 2024 2025

description: This Mendeley Data release provides raw and processed wind and weather measurements from four urban sites in the southern Dominican Republic: San Cristóbal, Azua, Barahona and San Juan de la Maguana. Researchers used local meteorological stations between March 2024 and June 2025 to observe wind speed and direction, temperature, humidity and pressure. The two public Excel workbooks separate high-frequency raw samples, taken at ten- or thirty-minute intervals, from cleaned hourly aggregates. Repository version 1 is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is four placed sensors over about sixteen months, not a wind atlas for the whole country or turbine production measurements. Site exposure, sensor height and gap-filling by interpolation may affect microgeneration estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is estimating urban wind resource or testing small-turbine scenarios. data-renewables-ninja is a related generation-profile service, but no direct comparison or shared calibration was established. No workbook measurements were downloaded.
